Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odcs

Enum Class DataContractServerType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<DataContractServerType>
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.bitol.odcs.DataContractServerType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<DataContractServerType>, Constable
public enum DataContractServerType extends Enum<DataContractServerType>
DataContractServerType lists the standard types of server (infrastructure) where the data described by an ODCS data contract may reside. The Bitol standards carry these values as strings, and permit additional values, so the beans hold the string and this enumeration documents the standard values and provides a lookup.
